contract: process --retry-input-rejection opts one image into current request identity adoption; default/watch unchanged. It is not force reprocessing.
eligibility: Existing JPEG-named MPO failed input INVALID_IMAGE, no historical attempts, exact source version, successful fresh bounded validation, matching safe provenance, no output/temp/stage artifacts or references.
transaction: Preserve expected row CAS, source and evidence guards. Atomically adopt provider/model/prompt_hash with READY and newly staged path; preserve job ID and source/creation identity.
audit: Reuse immutable bounded publisher. Original byte-exact failure plus canonical deterministic transition evidence keyed by full payload digest, using complete identity fingerprints and original-provenance digest; no raw prompts, endpoint, auth material or tokens.
failure: Precommit transition evidence is preparation, not authorization; flag still required after rollback. Postcommit recovery follows adopted configuration. Never replay attempted or succeeded jobs.
observability: Report changed request settings, not necessarily changed prompt, and show process-only opt-in command. Preserve existing error codes and stdout output-path contract.
validation: Synthetic temp configs, fixtures and state only. Real photo and database remain untouched; user runs command personally.
